Browse Unicode characters and select them as unicode or hexadecimal HTML codes.

How to use

  • Pick a Unicode set from the dropdown.
  • Use PREV and NEXT to move through the available groups.
  • Click any cell to show the character with its Unicode and hexadecimal HTML entity below.
  • Copy or clear the code from the action buttons next to the output field.
